prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
engine_stated_criteria: listed and sold homes similar to yours in your neighborhood
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every West Palm Beach home—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, price range, and property type. Based on the available directory results, **Quan Nickler** is one candidate worth interviewing: her profile reports 114 sales and includes reviews from sellers, including a West Palm Beach home sale. **Tara Vernie** is another possibility, with 11 sales in the last 12 months and reviews that include sellers.

Before choosing, interview at least three agents who have recently **listed and sold homes similar to yours in your neighborhood**. Ask each for:
- Recent comparable sales and their list-to-sale prices
- A suggested price and the evidence behind it
- Their marketing and showing plan
- Who will handle the sale day to day
- Their commission and contract terms

You can compare local agents and sales histories through [Zillow’s West Palm Beach directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/west-palm-beach-fl/) and [Realtor.com’s directory](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/West-Palm-Beach_FL). If you share your ZIP code, home type, and approximate price range, I can help narrow down what to look for.
